name: web-cybersecurity-terminal-site-green-on-black
title: Cybersecurity site in monospace with neon green accents and glitchy scanned imagery
whatItIs: Two dark desktop screens with thin framed sections. The hero has monospace uppercase headline, a green 'Get a demo' button, a large glitchy white fingerprint image, partner logos and four stat cells. A second view, 'Who we protect', is a grid of scanline-like icons of cloud, chart, DNA, cart, bolt and tower with green highlight on hover.
whatItMeans: Technical, secure and slightly hacker-ish; scanline imagery feels like surveillance data.
techniques: Use monospace type and thin corner-bracket frames like a terminal.
Render icons and hero art as noisy scanline halftones.
Limit colour to black, grey-white and neon green.
Highlight the active card with a green gradient border.
Present stats in a row of dark cells.

vocabulary.definition: Small L-shaped marks on the corners of a frame.
Graphics made from fine horizontal noisy lines.
Interface type where every letter has equal width.
A card given accent colour when active.
